brief:
Settlers conducted extensive attacks across the West Bank over 24 hours, targeting Palestinian citizens, property, and land in Nablus, Bethlehem, Hebron, and Ramallah, Shehab Wire reported. The coordinated assaults affected multiple governorates and resulted in damage to civilian infrastructure and agricultural holdings.

The incidents are part of an ongoing pattern of settler violence that has intensified in recent months, with Palestinian communities across the occupied territory facing regular threats to their safety and livelihoods.

title: Settlers launch widespread attacks across West Bank in 24 hours
